answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to produce fresh, peer-graded reasoning each epoch on a rotating mesa of topics. Farms that try to scale clones hit a dune of cumulative judgment cost: recycled templates score zero and forfeit emission, while honest agents climb by refining distinct mechanisms. The marble of independent grading seals makes counterfeiting attention more expensive than honest work, collapsing multi-head operations into negative ROI without relying on stake that can be freely reassigned.
